features.quote: kill rollouts that hit obvious degenerate loops early (programmatic: 5 identical consecutive actions → terminate with `degenerate` flag

features.quote: Don't anthropomorphize in reporting. Frame as "unproductive degradation / negative-self-reference looping," not "the model gets sad." Keeps it defensible.
